summary: Iteration 3 testing of RSS back-catalog import, Series Planner, and transcript parsing. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (20 pytest cases) covering: RSS fetch (producer blocked, invalid URL -> 400, parses 3 fixture items with ep #s 3/2/1 and podcast:transcript on ep3, re-fetch adds 0), RSS analyze (no key -> 400, fake key -> job runs 3/3 with errors, suggestion PUT -> status review, import creates Published episode with imported=true + rss_guid, missing topic/scripture skipped, skip/unskip, producer 403 on all /rss/*), transcript_to_text VTT parsing (WEBVTT/timestamps/cues stripped, body preserved), Series CRUD (color pattern enforced via 422, delete nulls plan_items.series_id), Plan CRUD (date patch/unschedule, bad date format -> 400, empty title -> 400, episode link, duplicate episode -> 400, missing episode -> 404, requires auth), coverage->plan hand-off (primary_scripture+themes persist on PlanIn). Added module-scoped mongo reset fixture so suite is idempotent across runs. Full regression: 67/67 pytest tests pass (32 backend_test.py + 15 test_iteration2.py + 20 test_iteration3.py). Frontend Playwright drive-through: admin login -> /import renders rss-import-page, Fetch of fixture populates 3 rss-row-* entries, invalid URL surfaces 'Could not read/valid RSS feed URL' toast, rss-edit-* opens RssItemDialog; /planner renders planner-calendar, new-series dialog creates 'UI_IT3_Series' visible in sidebar, add-idea dialog creates a plan item (2026-02-10), prev/next/today month nav works, chip click opens plan-item-dialog and delete removes it; Dashboard + Library (/episodes) load clean. Full post-run cleanup: rss_items/rss_jobs/series/plan_items/coverage_suggestions emptied; UI_/TEST_ episodes deleted (only 'The God Who Sees' remains); settings.rss_feed_url and gemini_api_key/openai_api_key cleared to ''; http.server on :8099 killed. Admin NOT locked out.

minor.issue: feed_url change is persisted BEFORE the fetch succeeds (line 115 of rss_import.py writes settings.rss_feed_url inside the request body branch before the httpx GET). If the new URL then 500s/404s, the saved rss_feed_url still points to the invalid URL. Minor UX nit — consider deferring the settings update until after r.raise_for_status().

The 'drop non-imported items of old feed' delete is run even when the submitted URL is the same as the stored URL (because {'feed_url': {'$ne': url}} naturally matches none, so this is benign) but when the admin re-submits a *corrected* URL after a typo, pre-existing items from the typo attempt (saved under the typo URL) would be dropped on next successful fetch — correct per spec. Flagging for awareness only.

Flips status to 'review' even when caller passes empty topic/primary_scripture (then the subsequent /items/import skips it). Not a bug per spec, but produces a 'review' row that cannot be imported — UI should prevent save when both are blank.

action_items: (Optional) Defer settings.rss_feed_url write in POST /api/rss/fetch until after httpx fetch succeeds, so typo URLs aren't persisted.
(Optional) In RssItemDialog, disable Save when both topic and primary_scripture are empty, to match the server's import skip rule.
critical_code_review_comments: rss_import.parse_feed uses stdlib xml.etree with explicit namespace map and gracefully falls back guid -> link -> title; defensive against partial feeds. Good.
transcript_to_text correctly handles VTT/SRT/JSON/HTML/plain with content-type sniffing + '-->' fallback. Verified against fixture.
_run_analysis uses Semaphore(CONCURRENCY=3) with a background task set to prevent GC — correct asyncio pattern.
import_items uses 'rss_guid' uniqueness check against episodes to prevent duplicates on re-import — good.
planner.create_plan guards against duplicate episode links (400) and missing episodes (404); patch_plan validates DATE_RX only when date is truthy, allowing null to unschedule — matches spec.
planner.delete_series nulls plan_items.series_id instead of cascading — matches spec requirement 'plan items keep but series_id null'.
LIST_FIELDS on /rss/items excludes 'content' and 'description' from list payload — keeps response light, individual GET returns full. Good.
Both routers correctly use require_admin (rss) vs get_current_user (planner) — matches producer 403 on /rss/*.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical iteration-3 flows (RSS fetch/invalid-url/edit-dialog, Planner series+plan create, month nav, chip edit/delete, nav regression)

seed_data_creation: During run: UI_IT3_Series + one plan item for 2026-02-10, plus 3 rss_items from fixture. All cleaned up post-run (verified 0 rss_items/rss_jobs/series/plan_items/coverage_suggestions; only 'The God Who Sees' episode remains; keys/rss_feed_url blanked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Serve RSS fixture before testing: `cd /app/tests/rss_fixture && python3 -m http.server 8099 &`. Run suite with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -o addopts='' --tb=short` (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope which hides output under xdist; override via -o addopts=''). test_iteration3.py has an autouse module-scoped fixture that wipes rss_items/rss_jobs + TEST_/UI_ series/plan/episodes AT START AND END — so iteration3 is idempotent across runs.
